---
title: "Reinforcement learning"
---

Reinforcement learning studies how an agent can choose actions through trial and
error in order to maximize long-term reward. Unlike supervised learning, the
agent's actions influence which rewards and future situations it experiences.

## Multi-armed bandits

In a multi-armed bandit, the agent repeatedly chooses among actions with
unknown, noisy rewards. This smallest reinforcement-learning setting lets us
separate the central tradeoff between gathering information and exploiting the
best option found so far.
